1: ---
     2: # This playbook is used to run preliminary upgrade checks for the hosts in the ACS deployment.
     3: - name: Include vars based on acs major version
     4:   ansible.builtin.import_playbook: include-vars.yml
     5: 
     6: - name: Run preliminary upgrade checks for all hosts
     7:   hosts: all:!external
     8:   gather_facts: false
     9:   tasks:
    10:     - name: Fetch status file with installed versions
    11:       ansible.builtin.fetch:
    12:         src: "{{ ansible_installation_status_file }}"
    13:         fail_on_missing: false
    14:         dest: /tmp/
    15:       register: ansible_components_status
    16:       changed_when: false
    17: 
    18:     - name: Read installed versions from status file when available
    19:       ansible.builtin.include_vars:
    20:         file: /tmp/{{ inventory_hostname }}/{{ ansible_installation_status_file }}
    21:         name: installed_components
    22:       when: ansible_components_status.msg is undefined
    23: 
    24:     - name: Check for unsupported components upgrades
    25:       any_errors_fatal: true
    26:       module_defaults:
    27:         ansible.builtin.fail:
    28:           msg: >
    29:             You're trying to upgrade in an unsupported manner!
    30:             Please read our documentation for more informations on what's supported and what isn't.
    31:             https://github.com/Alfresco/alfresco-ansible-deployment/blob/master/docs/components-upgrade.md
    32:       block:
    33:         - name: Fail on unsupported ACS upgrade
    34:           ansible.builtin.fail:
    35:           when:
    36:             - installed_components.acs is defined
    37:             - installed_components.api_explorer is defined
    38:             - |
    39:               acs_play_repository_acs_edition != installed_components.acs.edition or
    40:               acs_play_repository_acs_version.split('.')[:3] | join('.') != installed_components.acs.version.split('.')[:3] | join('.') or
    41:               acs_play_repository_acs_version is version(installed_components.acs.version, 'lt') or
    42:               acs_play_repository_api_explorer_version != installed_components.api_explorer.version
    43: 
    44:         - name: Initialize evaluation of currently installed amps
    45:           ansible.builtin.set_fact:
    46:             amps: {}
    47: 
    48:         - name: Add common amps
    49:           ansible.builtin.set_fact:
    50:             amps: >-
    51:               {{ amps | combine({
    52:                 'aos_module': {
    53:                   'version': acs_play_repository_amp_aos_module_version
    54:                 },
    55:                 'googledrive_repo': {
    56:                   'version': acs_play_repository_amp_googledrive_repo_version
    57:                 },
    58:                 'googledrive_share': {
    59:                   'version': acs_play_repository_amp_googledrive_share_version
    60:                 }
    61:               }) }}
    62: 
    63:         - name: Add device sync amp
    64:           ansible.builtin.set_fact:
    65:             amps: >-
    66:               {{ amps | combine({
    67:                 'device_sync': {
    68:                   'version': acs_play_repository_amp_device_sync_version
    69:                 }
    70:               }) }}
    71:           when: acs_play_repository_acs_edition == 'Enterprise'
    72: 
    73:         - name: Add extra amps if provided and required properties are set
    74:           vars:
    75:             # Vars commonly used in the list that are not accessible by this
    76:             # playbook as they are not defined in the repository group_vars
    77:             # file. Nexus credentials are comming from common role which
    78:             # eventually will be moved to global secrets.
    79:             repository_content_folder: ""
    80:             nexus_user: ""
    81:             nexus_password: ""
    82:           ansible.builtin.set_fact:
    83:             amps: >-
    84:               {{ amps | combine({
    85:                 item.name: {
    86:                   'version': item.version
    87:                 }
    88:               }) }}
    89:           loop: "{{ acs_play_repository_extra_amp_downloads | default([]) }}"
    90:           when: item.name is defined and item.version is defined
    91: 
    92:         - name: Fail on unsupported AMPS upgrades
    93:           ansible.builtin.fail:
    94:           when: |
    95:               installed_components is defined and
    96:               installed_components.amps is defined and
    97:               item in amps and
    98:               amps[item].version != installed_components.amps[item].version
    99:           loop: "{{ installed_components.amps | list }}"
   100: 
   101:         - name: Fail on unsupported Transformers upgrades
   102:           ansible.builtin.fail:
   103:           when:
   104:             - installed_components.transform is defined
   105:             - acs_play_transformers_aio_version != installed_components.transform.version
   106: 
   107:         - name: Fail on unsupported Trouter upgrades
   108:           ansible.builtin.fail:
   109:           when:
   110:             - installed_components.trouter is defined
   111:             - acs_play_trouter_version != installed_components.trouter.version
   112: 
   113:         - name: Fail on unsupported SFS upgrades
   114:           ansible.builtin.fail:
   115:           when:
   116:             - installed_components.sfs is defined
   117:             - acs_play_sfs_version != installed_components.sfs.version
   118: 
   119:         - name: Fail on unsupported Search upgrades
   120:           ansible.builtin.fail:
   121:           when:
   122:             - installed_components.search is defined
   123:             - acs_play_search_version != installed_components.search.version
   124: 
   125:         - name: Fail on unsupported Sync upgrades
   126:           ansible.builtin.fail:
   127:           when:
   128:             - installed_components.sync is defined
   129:             - acs_play_sync_version != installed_components.sync.version
